scene.ko: 협력사 손님에게 회사와 하루 일정을 소개하고, 손님의 비행기 시간이 바뀌자 일정을 다시 짠다.

lines.en: Good morning, Ms. Rivera. Before we begin, let me give you a quick overview of our company and today's schedule.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 리베라 씨. 시작하기 전에 저희 회사와 오늘 일정을 간단히 소개해 드릴게요.
alt: Good morning, Ms. Rivera. First, I'd like to briefly introduce our company and go over today's schedule.

lines.en: That would be great, thank you.
We were founded in 2009, and today we make sensors for about forty companies in eight countries.
lines.ko: 저희는 2009년에 설립됐고, 지금은 8개국 40여 개 회사에 센서를 만들어 공급하고 있어요.
alt: We started in 2009, and now we supply sensors to around forty companies in eight countries.

lines.en: Impressive. And what's the plan for today?
This morning, you'll meet our engineering team. After lunch, we'll visit the factory, and we'll finish with dinner at six.
lines.ko: 오전에는 엔지니어링 팀을 만나시고요. 점심 후에는 공장을 방문하고, 6시 저녁 식사로 마무리합니다.
alt: In the morning, you'll meet our engineers. After lunch, we'll tour the factory, and dinner is at six.

lines.en: Actually, I'm sorry, but my flight was moved up, and I need to leave for the airport by four.
lines.ko: 실은, 죄송하지만 비행기 시간이 앞당겨져서 4시까지는 공항으로 출발해야 해요.

lines.en: That's not a problem at all. In that case, would you prefer to see the factory right after the engineering meeting, before lunch?
lines.ko: 전혀 문제없어요. 그렇다면 엔지니어 미팅 바로 다음, 점심 전에 공장을 보시겠어요?
alt: No problem. Would you like to visit the factory before lunch, right after you meet the engineers?

lines.en: That would help a lot. But I don't want to cause any trouble for your team.
lines.ko: 그러면 정말 도움이 되겠어요. 그런데 팀에 폐를 끼치고 싶지는 않아요.

lines.en: It's no trouble at all. The factory is only fifteen minutes away. And instead of dinner, we could have a working lunch, so we still have time to discuss the contract.
lines.ko: 전혀요. 공장은 15분 거리밖에 안 돼요. 그리고 저녁 대신 점심을 먹으면서 회의하면 계약 이야기를 할 시간도 있어요.
alt: Not at all. The factory is just fifteen minutes from here. We could also have a working lunch instead of dinner, so we can still talk about the contract.

lines.en: Perfect. Thank you for being so accommodating.
